description: This Java class 'LoanStatusChecker' provides utility methods to verify the status and substatus of loans within the Apache Fineract integration tests. It includes methods for checking if loans are approved, waiting for disbursal, pending, active, closed, overpaid, foreclosed, or rejected. It also includes methods to retrieve loan status information from the server.

classes.name: LoanStatusChecker
classes.description: A utility class for verifying various statuses and substatuses of loans in integration tests.

methods.name: verifyLoanIsApproved
methods.description: Asserts that the loan's status is not pending approval, indicating it is approved.

methods.name: verifyLoanIsWaitingForDisbursal
methods.description: Asserts that the loan's status is waiting for disbursal.

methods.name: verifyLoanIsPending
methods.description: Asserts that the loan's status is pending approval.

methods.name: verifyLoanIsActive
methods.description: Asserts that the loan's status is active.

methods.name: verifyLoanAccountIsClosed
methods.description: Asserts that the loan account is closed.

methods.name: verifyLoanAccountIsNotActive
methods.description: Asserts that the loan account is not active.

methods.name: verifyLoanAccountIsOverPaid
methods.description: Asserts that the loan account is overpaid.

methods.name: verifyLoanAccountForeclosed
methods.description: Asserts that the loan account sub-status is 'Foreclosed'.

methods.name: verifyLoanAccountRejected
methods.description: Asserts that the loan account sub-status is 'Rejected'.

methods.name: getStatusOfLoan
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a specified loan from the server.

methods.name: getSubStatusOfLoan
methods.description: Retrieves the sub-status of a specified loan from the server.
